moduleCalculatorDescription: Exact arithmetic, scientific expressions, units, statistics and fractional base conversion.
moduleStoichiometryDescription: Molar masses, solutions, limiting reagents and reaction yields.
moduleSpreadsheetDescription: Tables, formulas and delimited-file import with original values retained.
moduleChemicalDescription: Import CDXML drawings and SMILES structures, retaining original files.
modulePdfDescription: Compose independent PDF documents with their own text and page layouts.
moduleCollaborationDescription: Verified contacts, encrypted review exchange and signed record reviews.
moduleInventoryDescription: Owned items, materials, equipment and software. Track central stock and its allocation across projects.
modulePlanningDescription: Calendars, tasks and equipment bookings for each location and your combined overview.
moduleResearchDescription: Lab books are always available within projects. Enable the types you need, or create your own record templates in any lab book.
moduleSamplesDescription: Register samples, enter analysis results and review result sheets.
modulePublishingDescription: Compose a website from research and prepare it for publication.
pinnedItem: This card is pinned to one item.
noFields: No additional fields for this source.
widthHelp: Width follows the available dashboard space. Content determines the minimum height.
moveSettingsHelp: Drag to move settings. Arrow keys move this panel.
unavailableProjectSelection: A selected project is unavailable. Update Data from in this card’s settings.
noScope: No projects or workspace data selected
unavailableBookSelection: A selected lab book has moved or is unavailable. Update the card’s selection.
dropCardHelp: Drop a card on the dashboard to place it.
cardPickedUp: Card picked up. Arrow keys move it; Enter places it; Escape cancels.
featureUnavailable: This feature is currently unavailable. Its card settings are retained.
foreignWorkspace: Open the workspace this card belongs to to display its data.
loadDataFailed: This data could not be loaded.
itemUnavailable: This item is unavailable. Its card settings are retained.
cardFailed: This card could not be displayed. Its settings are retained.
resizeHelp: Drag to resize. Arrow keys change size; Home restores natural height.
openWorkspace: Open a workspace to use the dashboard.
emptyDesktop: Drag data here from the toolbar or library to build your dashboard.
dragHelp: Drag a card by its heading. With the heading focused, press Space to pick it up, arrows to move, Enter to place or Escape to cancel.
saveBeforeDisable: Save or cancel this module’s settings before turning it off.
cardClosed: Card closed. Restore it from Closed cards.
openBeforeEnable: Open a workspace before enabling tools.
finishSettings: Save or cancel the open settings before editing another module.
projectToolHelp: Choose each project separately. Changes take effect when you save; existing data is kept.
createProjectForTool: Create a project to use this tool there.
reopenProjectTools: Reopen this workspace before saving its project tools.
chooseQuantity: Choose at least one quantity in Content settings.

usedSelectedBoms: Used in BOMs from selected stock
scrappedSelectedBoms: Scrapped in BOMs from selected stock
itemUnitHelp: Leave empty to use each item’s unit.
inventoryLocationsHelp: Workspace inventory is available here without selecting any projects. Choose which projects show an inventory view. Enabling a view does not assign stock; use transfers to allocate it.
